definitions.explanation: A hollow ceramic pig with an opening in its side, used to hold a burning mosquito coil. A familiar emblem of Japanese summer, often seen on verandas and in seasonal advertising.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: A mosquito coil pig is sitting on the veranda.

examples.japanese: {蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風物詩|ふうぶつし}→風物詩：08649_fuubutsushi⟧だ。
examples.english: The mosquito coil pig is one of the sights of summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}→蚊取り線香：06751_katorisenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: At my grandmother's house they still put mosquito coils in the ceramic pig and use it.

notes:
From {蚊遣|かや}り (driving off mosquitoes) plus ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ (pig). Also written ⟦{蚊取|かと}り→蚊取り：23175_katori⟧⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to set out a mosquito coil pig
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風物詩|ふうぶつし}→風物詩：08649_fuubutsushi⟧: a seasonal sight of summer
- ⟦{蚊取|かと}り{線香|せんこう}→蚊取り線香：06751_katorisenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put a coil inside it

CULTURAL NOTE:
The shape is said to derive from Edo-period pots used to burn smoky material against mosquitoes. Today it is as much a nostalgic ornament as a practical device, and it appears constantly in summer illustrations alongside wind chimes and watermelon.
